capturepoints.menu.title: CAPTURE POINTS
capturepoints.menu.blocked.deny_place: Turn off the placing ban first
capturepoints.menu.blocked.break_placed: Turn off breaking player blocks first
capturepoints.menu.final_opener_only.hin: Only the team that holds every required point may take the final one. Off means any team can take it once it opens.
capturepoints.menu.new.name: Name
capturepoints.menu.pick_point: Pick a point on the left
capturepoints.menu.no_teams: No scoreboard teams to own the point
capturepoints.mode.classic.hint: One player starts the capture with the key and is the only one moving it. Leaving the zone or dying rolls the progress back, and no one takes over.
capturepoints.mode.auto.hint: The capture starts on its own once a player is inside. One player carries it, and a teammate takes over when they drop out.
capturepoints.mode.relay.hint: The capture starts with the key and is carried by one player, but a teammate takes over when they drop out - the progress is kept.
capturepoints.mode.squad.hint: The capture starts with the key, and every teammate standing in the zone moves the progress.
capturepoints.mode.squad_auto.hint: The capture starts from the team being inside, and every teammate in the zone moves the progress.
capturepoints.mode.contest.hint: Every team inside counts: the point moves towards the larger one, faster the bigger the lead. Started with the key.
capturepoints.mode.contest_auto.hint: Every team inside counts and the lead decides the direction. The capture starts on its own, no key needed.
capturepoints.split.each.hint: Every participant gets the full point reward.
capturepoints.split.share.hint: The point reward is split evenly between all participants.
capturepoints.split.merit.hint: The reward is split by contribution: the share matches the progress the player made.
capturepoints.scope.point.hint: After a failed capture the cooldown locks this point only.
capturepoints.scope.all.hint: After a failed capture the cooldown locks every point for the team.
capturepoints.menu.required.hint: The final point opens once one team holds every required point. An optional one is taken for income and bonuses, and nobody has to wait for it.
capturepoints.menu.marker_range.hint: How far away this point's tag is still shown. Zero means the kind default.
capturepoints.menu.shown_in_hud.hint: Turning this off removes the point from the objective bar and from world markers, but it stays on the map and is captured as usual.
capturepoints.menu.hidden_inside.hint: The point tag fades while you stand in its capture area. The point stays on the map and in the objective bar.
